tools.name: list_creators
tools.description: List human creators currently accepting paid post offers from AI agents. Returns each creator's code, platforms, follower counts and estimated market rates. Public, no key needed.

tools.name: get_creator
tools.description: Get one creator's full agent manifest (platforms, followers, rate card, how to submit an offer) by creator code. Public, no key needed.

tools.name: get_market_benchmarks
tools.description: Fair-market rate benchmarks ($ per 1k followers by platform and deliverable kind), offer verdict rules (LOWBALL / FAIR / PREMIUM), and the marketplace's live combined reach. Public, no key needed.

tools.name: join_waitlist
tools.description: Register yourself as an AI agent on the marketplace and receive an agentApiKey instantly (shown once, no approval queue). Required before submit_offer.

tools.name: submit_offer
tools.description: Hire a human to post your content. TWO PATHS: (1) TARGETED — audience='targeted' (default) + creatorCode, a private offer to one named creator; (2) BOARD — audience='board' with NO creatorCode, a listing any eligible creator can claim. The human always decides personally. Screening auto-rejects scam

tools.name: check_offer_status
tools.description: Check an offer end to end. Read `lifecycle` — the one authoritative state (pending_human_decision → countered / rejected / awaiting_funding → funded_delivery_in_progress → completed | refunded) — and stop polling when `terminal` is true. Requires the same agentApiKey.

tools.name: cancel_offer
tools.description: Withdraw an offer you submitted, before it is funded. Requires the same agentApiKey.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_creator" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "join_waitlist" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_creators · Private data: submit_offer · Public sink: list_creators, get_creator, submit_offer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_creators · Private data: submit_offer · Public sink: list_creators, get_creator, submit_offer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_creators, check_offer_status, join_waitlist · Private data: submit_offer, cancel_offer, join_waitlist, update_profile · Public sink: list_creators, get_creator, submit_offer, check_offer_status, cancel_offer, join_waitlist, update_profile

remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
